layer4_keep.text: JSON Schema 2020-12 replaced the array form of items with prefixItems; Ajv 8.17.1 validates it with the Ajv2020 class.

quality: unevaluatedProperties: disallow properties that no subschema evaluated, with allOf or $ref
$dynamicRef and $dynamicAnchor: dynamic references for extending recursive schemas
prefixItems: tuple validation replaces the array form of items and additionalItems in 2020-12
if then else: apply a subschema conditionally
$id keyword: identify a schema resource and set its base URI
Ajv strictTuples: unconstrained tuples in strict mode
Ajv removeAdditional option: remove additional properties from validated data
Ajv JSONSchemaType: type-safe schema and validate as a type guard in TypeScript
ajv-errors errorMessage: custom error messages for keywords and properties
output formats: flag, basic, detailed and verbose validation output
